# 2026-09-27-readme-live-e2e-workflow

Correct the stale `Example Workflow` section in the root `README.md`: it still calls the concrete workflow planned even though `operator/e2e/WORKFLOW.md` and its production E2E documentation already exist. Update only that section to describe and link the current E2E workflow and `operator/e2e/README.md`. Keep the change factual and documentation-only. Verify the referenced files exist and run `git diff --check`.

# 2026-09-27-e2e-catalog-scenario-purpose

Clarify `operator/e2e/README.md` so a reader can choose between a default catalog E2E and a scenario run. State that the default randomly selects a catalog Plan to check the production lifecycle and PR delivery path, while `--plan` and `--workflow` supply targeted scenario inputs through the same production E2E path. Keep the addition concise and consistent with the current CLI; do not add a new mode or change runtime behavior. Verify the documented options against `operator/e2e/cli.mjs` and run `git diff --check`.

# 2026-09-27-e2e-run-timing-lookup

Add one concise `jq` example to `operator/e2e/README.md` showing how to inspect an existing `operator/e2e/runs/<run-id>/run.json` for workload source/catalog entry, workflow provenance, resolved hard cap, and observed run, Symphony, lifecycle, and chatgpt-shot timing. Use field names present in the current durable record implementation and keep the example documentation-only. Verify the fields against `operator/e2e/model/run-record-store.mjs` and run `git diff --check`.
